# Playful

Turn curiosity into enjoyable discovery and make participation feel inviting.

Choose a playful idea rooted in the subject and develop a coherent visual language around it. Use expressive typography, illustration, surprising compositions, and responsive details. In interactive work, reward an action with an immediate, understandable response; in static work, create discovery through visual wit, contrast, and details worth noticing.

Keep navigation and meaningful choices recognizable. Match the humor and energy to the audience: play can be clever, warm, mischievous, or exuberant. Make the subject enjoyable to engage with while keeping the person's purpose apparent.
